The Outer Criterion on the Compiled Route

Source: R/engine_outer.R
engine_outer_at.Rd

engine_outer_at() returns the compiled context of an outer point, from which statmod_marginal(), statmod_marginal_grad() and statmod_marginal_hess() read the criterion, its gradient and its Hessian on the models that the compiled route covers, or NULL where the R route computes them.

Usage

engine_outer_at(ctx, spec, design, coef, hyper, method, basis = NULL)

engine_outer_build(spec, design, coef, hyper, basis)

engine_outer_members(spec, design, idx, hyper)

engine_ctx_solve(ctx, x)

engine_flags

engine_outer_complete(eo, spec, design, coef, hyper)

engine_outer_mvt(u, un, coef, spec, hyper)

engine_outer_chart(u, hyper)

Format

engine_flags: an environment of switches of the compiled route.

Arguments

ctx

An evaluation context from outer_context(), or NULL.

spec, design, coef, hyper, method, basis

As for statmod_marginal().

idx

The outer index.

x

A vector of the length of the stacked coefficients.

eo

An outer context of engine_outer_at().

u

A penalized unit of statmod_penalized() whose penalty is a multivariate gaussian prior.

un

The unit's description by engine_penalty_units().

Value

engine_outer_at(): an external pointer, or NULL. engine_outer_members(): a list with mrow, munit, mchain, h1 and h2, or NULL where a member is not covered.

Details

A point is covered when spec@engine is "auto", the method is reml() or ml() on the observed information, the model is one that engine_model() describes, the family carries its derivatives to the fourth order in the registry, and every penalized unit is a quadratic penalty or a gaussian prior with a fixed mean and no map. The compiled context computes, at the mode, the derivatives of the log-density to the fourth order on the link scale, the observed information, the penalized information pinned at pinned_coords() with its inverse, the matrix of the traces and the leverages, as the evaluation context of outer_context() holds them. Where the R route would take a branch that the compiled context does not reproduce (a curvature that is not finite, a Cholesky factor that fails or whose condition is within a factor of 100 of the acceptance threshold of pd_factor(), and therefore the eigendecomposition and the retry over deficient_coords()), the context reports it and the R route computes the point. The context is stored in ctx, keyed by the integrated basis, so that the criterion, the gradient and the Hessian at one point read one context.

engine_outer_members() describes the outer index to the compiled context: for each member line of index_members() its row, the position of its penalized unit in statmod_penalized(), and the derivative of its hyperparameter's inverse link at its value; and, for each row, the first and second derivatives of the inverse link at the first member's value, which the Hessian reads.

engine_ctx_solve() returns \(K^{-1}x\) with \(K\) the mode's pinned penalized information, from the compiled context that ctx already holds, or NULL where ctx holds none or the context does not cover the point, in which case the caller reads the inverse of ctx_penalized(). inner_mode_error() and criterion_resolution() read it. The switch engine_flags$mode_inverse turns it off.

engine_outer_complete() gives the context the derivatives of each multivariate t prior in its hyperparameters (engine_outer_mvt()), which the criterion does not read, before the first gradient or Hessian. It returns the context, or NULL where a prior is not covered.

engine_outer_mvt() describes a multivariate Student t prior to the compiled context at the mode: the derivatives of the penalty in its hyperparameters (penalties7::penalty_grad_theta(), penalties7::penalty_hess_theta(), penalties7::penalty_cross(), penalties7::penalty_dcross()), the blocks of penalties7::penalty_dhessian() and penalties7::penalty_d2hessian() group by group, whether penalties7::beta_quadratic() holds, and per hyperparameter the derivative of the inverse scale matrix (zero for nu) and of nu + p (one for nu), from which the compiled context forms the movement of the penalty's Hessian with the coefficients. It returns NULL where the chart's free values do not match the hyperparameters.

engine_outer_chart() describes the covariance chart of a multivariate gaussian prior to the compiled context: a code (1 for parameters7::log_cholesky(), of the covariance or of the precision, 2 for parameters7::compound_symmetry(), 3 for parameters7::ar1()), the free values of the chart in its own order, which is the order of the penalty's hyperparameters, and, for the last two, the inverse links of the scale and of the correlation with their first two derivatives at the free values. It returns NULL for any other chart.

See also

engine_inner_fit(), statmod_marginal()
